categories.refused_network: Address refused by the network rules

list.caption: Webhooks
list.suspendedUntil: Deliveries suspended until {date} after repeated failures.

test.rateLimited: Too many tests: at most {max} per hour. Try again later.
test.rateLimitedRetry: Too many tests: at most {max} per hour. Try again in {minutes} min.

form.createIntro: The receiver gets one request per selected event. No file name, link or password is ever sent.
form.editIntro: Leave the address empty to keep the current one. Re-enabling a suspended webhook resumes its deliveries at once.
form.discardConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Close without saving? They will be lost.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Describes the receiver, for example “Security team channel” (100 characters at most).

hints.teams: Incoming webhook of a Microsoft Teams channel (or a Workflows URL): a formatted message.
hints.slack: Incoming webhook of a Slack channel: a formatted message.
hints.generic: Any HTTPS receiver (SIEM, script): a JSON document signed with a secret shown once.

url.label: Address (URL)
url.hint: Full https:// address given by the receiver, at most {max} characters. It is stored encrypted and never shown again in full.
url.editHint: Current address: {hint}. Leave empty to keep it.

events.label: Events
events.hintTenant: Alerts of this entity to send. Addresses are only included if the entity allows it (General screen).
events.hintSystem: Alerts of the whole instance to send. The events of the entities are never sent to these webhooks.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.hint: A disabled webhook receives nothing until it is enabled again.

secret.text: The receiver uses this secret to check the X-TransTeira-Signature header of each request. Copy it now into the configuration of the receiver.
secret.label: Signing secret

rotate.title: Generate a new secret for {name}?
rotate.text: The current secret stops working at once: requests are signed with the new one, which you must enter in the receiver. Its previous key is destroyed.

delete.title: Delete the webhook {name}?
delete.text: The receiver no longer gets any alert, and deliveries in progress are abandoned. The encrypted address and secret are destroyed. This action cannot be undone.

addresses.included: The alerts of this entity include the addresses concerned.
addresses.excluded: The alerts of this entity do not include any address.

errors.nameTooLong: The name is limited to {max} characters.
errors.urlInvalid: Enter the full address given by the receiver, starting with https and its host name.
errors.urlCredentials: The address must not contain a user name or a password.
errors.urlTooLong: The address is limited to {max} characters.
errors.eventNotAllowed: One of the selected events is not available for these webhooks.
errors.limit: At most {max} webhooks: delete one before adding another.
errors.rateLimited: Too many new webhook addresses: at most {max} creations and address changes per hour. Try again later.
errors.rateLimitedRetry: Too many new webhook addresses: at most {max} creations and address changes per hour. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.notFound: This webhook no longer exists. Reload the page.
